officialApps.name: N Chord
officialApps.subtitle: Music Discovery, Moods & High-Fidelity Listening
officialApps.description: N Chord is N Studio's dedicated music streaming and discovery application. Explore curated Top Picks for You, browse Recents, and discover playlists tailored to your mood across Home, Explore, Library, and Search — all wrapped in a sleek dark interface with a floating Liquid Glass navigation bar.
officialApps.changelog:
• Official N Chord v1.9 release
• Top Picks for You, Recents, and Find Your Mood discovery
• Floating pill navigation bar with Home, Explore, Library, and Search

officialApps.name: N Stream
officialApps.subtitle: Movies, Series, Cast & CineSimkl Discovery Hub
officialApps.description: N Stream is N Studio's universal entertainment and series discovery hub. Browse detailed show and movie pages with trailers, full cast profiles, episode guides, genre tags, CineSimkl watchlist integration, and casting support.
officialApps.changelog:
• Universal build v0.5.7 (Build 125)
• CineSimkl integration, trailers, cast & episode browser
• Casting and watchlist synchronization

officialApps.name: N Flix
officialApps.subtitle: Movies, TV Shows & Anime Streaming
officialApps.description: N Flix delivers curated Movies, TV Shows, and Anime in a sleek dark cinema interface. Pick up right where you left off with Continue Watching, save titles to My List, and browse Trending This Week.
officialApps.changelog:
• N Flix v2.3.1 release
• Movies, TV Shows & Anime category filters
• Continue Watching progress tracking and My List

officialApps.name: N EMMX
officialApps.subtitle: Music, Mixes, Gaming & Video Streaming
officialApps.description: N EMMX brings together Music, Mixes, Gaming, and Natok video feeds in a fast, clean Android client with category tabs, channel feeds, search, and a floating pill bottom navigation bar.
officialApps.changelog:
• N EMMX v0.5.114 (Build 123)
• Category tabs for All, Music, Mixes, Gaming, and Natok
• Floating pill Home, Subscriptions, Explore, Search, and Library navigation
